study: Is round-5 T1's 12-1 momentum excess (top 5 of ~108 mega-caps, 20-day hold) real, or survivorship?
prior: LONGER_HOLDS_2026-09-27 already found no alpha for monthly 12-1 momentum on the ~900-name liquid point-in-time universe (OOS alpha +1.4..+3.3%/yr, t <= 0.3). This test isolates survivorship at T1's own scale.
data: /tmp/lh/panel.npz on the mini via lh_core.load (Alpaca SIP adjusted daily 2016-01..2026-09-25, active + inactive names; inactive coverage from 2018; delisted names held at their last close).

universes.PIT100: each month-end t: the 100 names with the highest 20-day average dollar volume among eligible (price >= $5) names with 252 sessions of history, using data through t only
universes.SURV100: the same ranking but restricted to names that are still active today (status == active): the survivorship-biased analogue of T1's list

rule: at each month-end close t, rank the universe by 12-1 momentum (close t-21 / close t-252 - 1); hold the top 5 and top 10 equal-weight to the next month-end close
baseline: the equal-weight universe over the same month (T1's 'random picks') and SPY
cost: 10 bp per month (round trip on full turnover at liquid-name spreads + 2 bp auction legs)
promotion: PIT100 top-5 excess vs its own universe > 0 in IS and OOS with pooled t >= 2. The SURV100 minus PIT100 gap estimates the survivorship lift in T1.
